title: Toast 打开任务（应用运行中）
expected: Clicking 打开任务 while the app is running opens the target task exactly once

title: Toast 冷启动激活
expected: Clicking a toast while the app is stopped cold-starts and opens the target task

title: 错误账号拒绝
expected: A toast for account A while B is active does not open A task and produces a rejection

title: 账号切换竞争拒绝
expected: Click during account switch is rejected without opening a wrong-account task

title: 已删除任务拒绝
expected: A toast for a deleted task does not open any task and produces a rejection

title: Listener 前多条 activation
expected: Multiple activations queued before the webview listener open in FIFO order

title: Listener 前多条 rejection
expected: Multiple rejections queued before the listener are delivered once each in FIFO order

title: 目标数据库损坏
expected: A damaged target database fails closed and keeps the source account active

title: 强杀后通知/恢复
expected: After forced process kill/restart, queue behavior matches the documented fail-closed/at-most-once contract

title: 重复点击
expected: Repeated click/activation opens a task at most once and does not duplicate toasts
